title: Output of the pairwise XOR process
statement: For a natural number $N$ and bit strings $p,u$, if $\min(|p|,|u|)\le N$, then concatenating the outputs of the pair-output rule on the encodings of the suffixes obtained by deleting $i$ bits from each string, for $0\le i<N$, gives the bitwise XOR of $p$ and $u$ up to the length of the shorter string.
